title: splitEvenly gives leftover cents to the last parts, as the venue's accountant asks; its comment is rewritten and writes the list as Array<Amount>
covers: a list kind written Array<T> where it was T[]
note: money's tests check that the parts add up and differ by at most a cent, and pass; billing's checks the same. splitEvenly accepts and hands back the same kinds; no bound or error changes.
